image_description: A close-up view of a grey whale's head and rostrum emerging vertically from blue ocean water. The skin is dark grey/black with distinctive white mottling and barnacle clusters (callosities). The rostrum is arched, and the two blowholes are visible at the top. The rest of the body is submerged.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows the characteristic arched rostrum and the paired blowholes at the apex of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture exhibits the correct mottled pattern with visible white callosities/barnacles typical of grey whales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The posterior back and dorsal area are completely submerged and outside the frame; this feature cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head is visible; the full body shape is occluded by water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the head checkpoint; visible skin matches the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed or submerged; baleen plates are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are submerged and not visible in this vertical spy-hopping pose.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Tail is completely submerged/out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: High-resolution detail confirms rough texture and barnacle encrustations.
